lines.text: body { margin: 0; color: var(--ink); background: #f8fbff; font: 16px/1.7 'DM Sans', sans-serif; }
.top-bar { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 10; background: rgba(255,255,255,.92); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); }
.top-bar .container { min-height: 74px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; }
.top-nav a { color: var(--muted); font-size: .92rem; font-weight: 600; transition: color .2s; }
.hero { padding: 120px 0 135px; color: var(--white); background: radial-gradient(circle at 85% 20%, #43a8ff 0, transparent 30%), linear-gradient(125deg, #102a43, #1261a0); }
.hero h1 { max-width: 700px; margin: 0 0 18px; font: 700 clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4.7rem)/1.08 'Playfair Display', serif; letter-spacing: -.04em; }

.cta-btn, button { display: inline-block; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; padding: 13px 22px; color: var(--white); background: var(--blue); font: 600 1rem 'DM Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .2s, box-shadow .2s, background .2s; }
.cta-btn:hover, button:hover { background: #075dcc; box-shadow: 0 10px 20px rgba(22,119,255,.25); transform: translateY(-2px); }
h2 { margin: 0 0 12px; color: var(--navy); font: 700 clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem)/1.2 'Playfair Display', serif; }
.about-grid, .contact-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 58px; margin-top: 34px; }
.product-card { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--white); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(16,42,67,.06); transition: transform .2s, box-shadow .2s; }
.product-card img { display: block; width: 100%; height: 180px; object-fit: cover; }
input, textarea { width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px 15px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--white); font: inherit; resize: vertical; }
input:focus, textarea:focus { outline: 3px solid rgba(22,119,255,.2); border-color: var(--blue); }
.contact-info { padding: 28px; border-radius: 16px; color: var(--muted); background: var(--sky); }
.footer { padding: 25px 0; color: #bcd2e5; background: var(--navy); text-align: center; }
